top: sections: List of form sections. Inputs refer to them by `id`. The section `general` always exists.
top: inputs: Map of inputs. Declaration order is the form order.
top: integrations: Map of integrations by name. The template reads them as `.Emporium.Integrations.<name>`.
top: components: Map of components by id. A component makes a workload editable and countable.
top: profiles: Preset sizing and settings. `default` names the preselected profile; every other key is a profile.
top: exports: Services this app offers to other installed apps. See [App connections](../guides/app-connections).
section: id: Section id that inputs refer to.
input: type: Value type. `secret` values are never returned by the API. `byteSize`, `cpu` and `memory` take quantities such as `1Gi` or `500m`.
input: default: Default value, shown in the form.
input: required: The form needs a value. Default `false`.
input: options: Choices of an `enum` input: plain values, or `{value, label}`. Required for `enum`.
input: min: Lower bound. A number, or a quantity for `byteSize`, `cpu` and `memory`.
input: pattern: Regular expression a string value must match.
input: path: Helm values path that receives the value. Omit it when `values.emporium.yaml` reads the value with `input "Key"`. Not allowed together with `ref`.
input: ref: Delivers a `secret` input by reference. Emporium stores the value in the app Secret `<app>-emporium-secrets` and writes the Secret name and key into the chart values. Not allowed together with `path`.
input: ref.namePath: Values path that receives the Secret name.
input: ref.keyPath: Values path that receives the key name. The key defaults to the input key.
input: ref.key: Fixed key name, for charts that insist on one.
input: installOnly: The value cannot change after install (volume claim sizes, topology choices).
input: growOnly: The value can only increase (volume sizes).
input: generate: Creates the value once at install and keeps it on every upgrade. Only valid for `type: secret`.
input: renamedFrom: Earlier keys of this input. Emporium carries the stored value over on upgrade. A listed key must not be declared now.
input: showIf: Shows the input only while another input has a value. A hidden input is reset to its default.
input: matrix: Lint renders the chart with this boolean input set both ways.
integration: type: Integration type. Each type has its own parameters, listed below.
integration: required: Whether the app needs the integration. Default `true`. An optional integration adds an `enabled` switch to the install form.
integration: bind: Sets chart values from integration outputs without a template: output name to values path. The output must exist for the type. Do not bind secret outputs.
ingress: hosts: Keys of extra hosts. `registry` gives `<subdomain>-registry.<zone>`, read as `Hosts.registry`.
ingress: redirectPaths: OIDC redirect paths of the app, added on every host.
ingress: access.default: Who may open the app by default: `public`, `authenticated` (any user) or `admins`.
ingress: skipPaths: Paths that need no login. An exact path, a prefix ending in one `*`, or `regex(<Go regexp>)` without commas.
ingress: disableGlass: Use no login proxy and no OIDC client; the app authenticates users itself.
oidc: adminScope: Ask for the Emporium admin scope.
oidc: ingress: Name of the ingress integration whose client this integration shares. Default: the first ingress integration.
storage: size: Volume size: a quantity, or `{default, growOnly}`.
storage: accessModes: Access modes of the claim. Default `ReadWriteOnce`.
storage: storageClass.default: Default storage class name. Empty: the provider default or the cluster default.
postgres: owner: Role that owns the database and that the app connects as.
postgres: extensions: Extensions to create at database initialization. List every extension the app needs.
postgres: storage: Volume size per instance: a quantity, or `{default, growOnly}`. It can only grow.
postgres: resources: CPU and memory for each instance.
postgres: secretKeys: Copies keys of the database credentials Secret into the app Secret under the names the chart wants: target name to source key.
redis: mode: `persistent` (append-only file, no eviction) or `cache` (no volume, LRU eviction). Default `persistent`.
redis: secretKeys: Copies provider Secret keys into the app Secret: target name to source key.
objectStorage: buckets: Buckets to create. At least one.
objectStorage: secretKeys: Copies provider Secret keys into the app Secret: target name to source key.
app: capability: The capability the other app must offer, such as `bitcoind-rpc/v1`. Matched by string equality.
app: permission: Permission level to request. The export must list it in `permissions`.
app: requires: Conditions on the facts of the chosen producer. A value is compared with the fact; `{sameAs: <name>}` compares with the same fact of an earlier `app` integration of this chart.
component: resources: Values path of the container resources map.
component: replicas: Replica rules. Use one form: `path` with optional `min` and `max`; `minPath` and `maxPath` for autoscaled workloads; or `fixed`.
component: replicas.path: Values path of the replica count.
component: replicas.minPath: Values path of the autoscaler minimum.
component: replicas.maxPath: Values path of the autoscaler maximum.
component: replicas.reason: Why the count is fixed, shown to the user.
component: storage: The component's volume size, set by `path` or by an `input`. One of the two.
component: storage.input: Key of an input that holds the size.
component: storage.installOnly: The size cannot change after install.
component: enabled: Values path (boolean) that turns an optional component off.
component: parent: Id of the parent component. Declares a sidecar container in the parent's pod, sized with the parent.
component: perNode: The component is a DaemonSet. Its footprint is multiplied by the number of nodes.
component: integration: Name of the integration that provides this workload, such as the PostgreSQL cluster.
component: knobs: Keys of inputs shown next to the component.
component: needsRWX: More than one replica needs a ReadWriteMany storage class.
component: match: Overrides how the component is matched to rendered workloads.
component: match.name: Workload name.
profiles: <name>.label: Name of the profile card.
profiles: <name>.values: Helm values file of the profile, `profiles/<name>.yaml`, relative to the chart root.
profiles: <name>.integrations: Parameter overrides per integration name for this profile.
options: installTimeout: How long an install waits, such as `10m`. Default `10m`.
options: requiredCRDs: CRDs that must exist before the install starts. Operators are required, never installed.
export: capability: Opaque id of the contract, such as `bitcoind-rpc/v1`.
export: service: Template for the name of the Service the chart renders for this export. The host is `<service>.<namespace>.svc`.
export: facts: Typed facts about the producer that consumers can require.
export: facts.<Name>.value: Value, or a template that renders to it.
export: facts.<Name>.immutable: The fact cannot change while a consumer is connected.
export: outputs: Extra string outputs for consumers: name to template.
export: permissions: Permission levels a consumer may request. The first is the default.
export: grantsPath: Values path where Emporium binds the list of connected consumers on every render. It must exist in `values.yaml` as a list with default `[]`.
export: grantRestarts: The producer restarts when its consumers change. The panel warns before a consumer is connected or removed.
export: credentials.kind: `none`: network access only. `rpcauth`: Emporium creates a user and password per consumer and passes the hash in the grant. `exported`: the chart publishes a Secret and Emporium copies the listed keys to each consumer.
export: credentials.secret: Template for the name of the Secret the chart renders without data. Required for `exported`.
export: credentials.keys: Output name to source key in that Secret, or to a map from permission to source key. Required for `exported`.
